items.q: Does an automated scan make a site compliant?
items.a: No tool can — and we say so on every report. Automated testing (we use axe-core, the same engine behind Lighthouse and axe DevTools) reliably catches the ~30–50% of WCAG issues that are machine-detectable. Each report lists exactly which criteria still need human review, so you set the right expectations and stay protected legally.

items.q: Which standards do you check against?
items.a: WCAG 2.2 Levels A & AA. Findings are mapped to the European Accessibility Act / EN 301 549 (our primary framing), plus ADA and Section 508 for US work — so one scan speaks to whichever obligation your client is under.

items.q: Can I put my own brand on the reports?
items.a: Yes, on any paid plan: your logo and brand color on white-label PDFs, plus the option to remove the "Powered by AccessAudit" mark on the Agency plan and up. Reports become a deliverable you can sell.

items.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
items.a: No. The Free plan needs no card — sign up and run your first scan in minutes. Upgrade only when you hit a limit.

We only fetch publicly accessible pages, and we store HTML snippets of flagged elements only — never a full copy of the site. Every workspace is isolated at the database row level, so no one else can see your audits. Cancel anytime from the billing portal.
